categories.main_business_segments: Tianneng Battery Group primarily operates in the battery manufacturing industry, focusing on lead-acid batteries, lithium-ion batteries, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion batteries, and solid-state batteries. Its business includes research, development, production, and sales of high-performance batteries and related new energy materials. The company also engages in battery recycling and energy storage solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as continuous casting and rolling for lead-acid batteries, intelligent manufacturing systems, and automated production lines for lithium-ion batteries. It has developed proprietary technologies in graphene composite materials, multi-component rare earth alloys, and advanced battery structures. Tianneng also focuses on energy management systems (EMS), battery management systems (BMS), and innovative materials for hydrogen fuel cells and solid-state batteries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tianneng serves primarily electric light vehicle manufacturers, including electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and micro electric vehicles. It also targets energy storage markets, industrial power applications, communication base stations, and transportation sectors such as rail transit and logistics. The company’s customers include OEMs, distributors, and end consumers in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production bases in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Henan, Guizhou, and Jiangxi provinces. It has expanded its global footprint with overseas production facilities, notably in Vietnam and Singapore, and actively promotes its brand in Southeast Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianneng operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the battery supply chain, focusing on battery manufacturing, assembly, and sales. It also manages upstream activities such as raw material procurement and recycling, and downstream services including distribution, after-sales, and energy storage solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment in next-generation battery technologies including lead-carbon, lithium-ion, sodium-ion, hydrogen fuel cells, and solid-state batteries. It pursues digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and global expansion. Tianneng collaborates with top universities and research institutes to accelerate technology commercialization and participates actively in industry standard setting.
categories.revenue_model: Tianneng generates revenue mainly through product sales of batteries and related energy storage systems. It also earns income from after-sales services, recycling of battery materials, and financial investments. The company’s sales channels include direct sales to OEMs and extensive dealer networks for replacement markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianneng is a leading player in the global lead-acid battery market and a prominent competitor in the Chinese new energy battery industry. It holds a top position in electric light vehicle power batteries and is recognized among the top 10 battery manufacturers in China. The company competes with other domestic and international battery producers in various segments including lithium-ion and hydrogen fuel cells.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tianneng reported revenues of approximately RMB 45 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.55 billion. The company’s total assets grew by 23.6% to RMB 44.3 billion, and net assets increased by 3%. Despite challenges such as raw material price volatility and market competition, Tianneng maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianneng emphasizes its technological innovation, product quality, and comprehensive service network as key differentiators. It offers a diversified product portfolio with advanced battery technologies tailored for various applications, ensuring safety, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. The company’s integrated digital marketing and after-sales service ecosystem enhances customer satisfaction and loyalty, supporting its leadership in green, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.
